title: [TTRP] Paintings!
description: A resource pack replaces 5 paintings from Vanilla Minecraft!
body:
A Resource Pack replaces 5 Vanilla Minecraft paintings to custom made, different paintings!
This is the first version of the pack and still on testing stage.
This resource pack for a minecraft server called TallTalesRP [TTRP].
Changed paintings goes as:
- Backyard
- Pond
- Skeleton
- Pointer
- Orb
- To:
- 4 custom made paintings
- +1 Different painting "Gravestone" made by me.
Though, pack is still on testing stage, there might be some problems but will be fixed in the next versions!
